newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Bavaria eyes Angola for growth.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Bavaria eyes Angola for growth.

text.p: Colombia's Bavaria plans to enter the retailing business in its home country and begin brewing beer in Angola as part of its 1997 expansion program, a senior company official said on Friday.
"Angola is a country -- now that its civil war has been overcome -- that offers promising prospects," Bavaria President Augusto Lopez told reporters.
"It's a country that is rich in many aspects, and we have prospects there that should yield good results," he said.
Bavaria also went into partnership with French retailer Carrefour to operate hypermarkets in four Colombian cities starting in the first half of next year, he said.

The Colombian company is carrying out feasibility studies that could lead to its opening of a thermoelectric plant in the eastern province of Casanare in partnership with British Petroleum Plc and Mosbacher of the United States, he said.
Bavaria's growth plans also include the likely purchase of a $150 million broadcast frequency to open a Colombia television station some time soon.
"We have very advanced studies that would allow us to be on the air in the shortest time possible," he said.
